subject: Request: convert intro demo into compressed technical bootcamp
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zephyr-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: zuri.ops@zephyr-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo scheduling for Zephyr

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the outreach. Quick update on our side — our Director of Product and a couple of engineers want this to be more hands-on than the standard intro. We were hoping to convert the 60-minute demo into a compact technical bootcamp / scoping session so we can get to implementation questions and surface constraints up front.

Complication: two of our key contributors (including that Director) are traveling the week of Jun 14–18 and have limited windows. Ideal for us would be a half-day on Mon Jun 21 (morning PT) so the exec can join before flying out. If that’s impossible, we can try to compress into a single 3.5–4 hour block on another date.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- run a compressed hands-on bootcamp (agenda + labs) instead of the intro demo, and
- run it in a ~4 hour contiguous block (we have 6 attendees: product, 2 backend, 1 infra, ops, exec).

If yes, please send a proposed agenda and any prework we should do so the session is efficient.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Zephyr Analytics
alex.johnson@zephyr-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Intro demo scheduling for Zephyr — proposed bootcamp agenda

Hi Alex — thanks for the clarity and the heads-up on travel. We can absolutely run a compressed technical bootcamp focused on scoping and integration patterns.

Two quick notes:
- We recommend a 4-hour half-day format for 6 attendees (lecture + 2 short hands-on labs + open Q&A). That keeps things efficient without losing depth.
- To make the session high-value for the exec, we’ll start with a 20-minute priorities + constraints review, then move into technical deep-dive.

I’ve attached a one-page proposed agenda and a short prework checklist (lightweight: sample API keys, a short data schema example). Marissa will run the labs and Ben will join for integration edge-cases.

Availability: we can run the half-day on Mon Jun 21 09:00–13:00 PT, or alternatively split into two 2-hour blocks on Tue Jun 22 and Wed Jun 23 if that helps accommodate travel. Which do you prefer?

If you confirm Jun 21, please send final attendee names and any constraints (VPN access, allowed test data) so we can tailor the labs. I’ll put a provisional calendar hold and share a final invite once you confirm.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (408) 555-0199

- Alex Johnson (exec)

Alex
